design_description: A striking purple-toned design built on the “Fracture” template, combining fractured textures with bold color contrasts. The jersey features jagged vertical tear patterns layered with shattered geometric fragments, creating the appearance of cracked crystal or broken stone. Multiple shades of purple are interrupted by light blue fracture streaks, adding depth, movement, and strong visual energy. Black collar, sleeve cuffs, and logos provide structure and help anchor the highly dynamic pattern. Overall, the design feels vibrant, aggressive, and modern — a high-impact interpretation of the Fracture template with a distinctive electric-purple identity.
